data.one_liner: Responsive values and widgets based on screen size using ScreenScope and Responsive classes
data.what_it_does: It lets you map screen scopes to values or widgets and resolve the appropriate one at runtime. It also provides a ScreenBuilder helper for quick widget switching.
use_when: You need responsive values for non-widget types (int, double, TextStyle, etc.)
You want a single source of truth for screen size based values
You prefer a declarative API over manual MediaQuery checks
avoid_when: You only need a few breakpoints and prefer hardcoded values
You need complex stateful logic that changes outside of screen size
strengths: Simple API, works with any design system
No extra dependencies beyond Flutter widgets
weaknesses: No built‑in theming or layout helpers beyond screen size
Limited to screen width/height and orientation only
Requires manual map ordering for breakpoint precedence

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a more comprehensive responsive layout system with breakpoints and adaptive widgets

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers similar screen size based widgets and helpers

alternatives.name: sizer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler API for sizing widgets based on screen dimensions
